guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: warning days, float limit, schedule colours, focus share and the days of code freeze.
List your projects on Projects and your people on Team. Baseline end, forecast end, manager and sponsor sit on the project row; slip and colour fill in.
Break each project into phases and work packages on Work Breakdown, then list the tasks on Task List with owner, dates, estimated hours, percent done and status.
Link tasks on Dependencies with a link type and a lag. The check column finds missing, circular and conflicting links before they hurt the plan.
Enter company holidays on Holidays and leave on Leave Calendar. Working Days shows the working days and team hours of each month and every end date skips closure days.
Set milestones, fixed dates and releases on Milestones, Fixed Dates and Releases. Slip, spare days, freeze dates and window checks fill in.
Keep each approved plan on Baselines and the dates of every phase on Phase Plan. Log every moved date on Schedule Changes and every late task on Delay Register.
Use Three-point Estimates before you commit to hours and Estimate Accuracy after tasks finish, so the next estimate starts from your own history.
Every Monday read Look-ahead and Critical Items: heavy weeks, people away, tasks with little float and the action and owner for each one.
Use the 14 calculators for end dates, working days, estimates, duration, float, buffer, delay impact, forecast end, catch-up, shifts, release windows, approvals and delay cost.
Print 10 sheets and 9 documents, follow 9 checklists and tap a message link to open your messaging app with the text ready.
Read Schedule Dashboard and Charts every week and send the sponsor note before dates move, not after.

listing.title: Project Schedule Excel Template: Task List, Dependencies, Milestones, Baselines, Holidays, Look-ahead, Critical Items
listing.headline: Plan, schedule and keep every project on its dates
listing.description:
Run the dates of every project in one Excel workbook. Projects holds the baseline end, the forecast end, the slip in days and a green, amber or red colour, while Task List carries every task with owner, dates, estimated hours, percent done and a live state: done, blocked, overdue, start late, slipping or due soon. Work Breakdown breaks each project into phases and work packages with hours checked against the tasks below them.

Dependencies links tasks with finish to start, start to start and finish to finish links, with a lag or a lead, and checks every link for missing, circular and conflicting dates. Milestones, Baselines, Phase Plan and Schedule Changes show what was planned, what is forecast and how far every date moved and why. Holidays, Leave Calendar and Working Days make every end date skip weekends and closure days, and flag leave that meets a task or a release.

Three-point Estimates and Estimate Accuracy turn best, likely and worst hours into an expected figure and compare it with the hours your tasks really took. Look-ahead shows twelve weeks of tasks starting and due against team capacity, Critical Items keeps a watch list by float, and Delay Register records the cause and the recovery action. Releases, External Dependencies and Fixed Dates track freeze dates, what you wait for and the penalty you would pay.

14 calculators cover end dates, working days, estimates, duration, float, buffer, delay impact, forecast end, catch-up, shifts, release windows, approvals and delay cost. Print 10 sheets and 9 documents, follow 9 checklists and send 30 ready messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part two of the Project manager suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a firm running twelve projects with fourteen people. It helps you plan your work and does not promise results.

signature.name: Working-day calendar with holidays and leave
signature.why: every end date skips weekends and your company holidays, and leave that meets a task or a release is flagged

signature.name: Three-point estimates with a width check
signature.why: best, likely and worst hours give expected hours, the range and a width warning; finished tasks show actual against estimated hours by phase

signature.name: Weekly look-ahead with team load

signature.name: Critical items watch list

signature.name: Release dates with freeze and window checks

competitors.lacks: give a task list and a bar chart but no working-day calendar, no dependency check and no warning when a task slips or an owner is missing
charge every month and keep your plan on their server; they show cards, not baseline against forecast, float or a delay register you own
one tab holds everything, so there are no baselines, phase plans, milestones, releases or look-ahead and nothing links to holidays and leave
draw bars from start and end dates but never calculate float, delay impact, catch-up hours or the end date from percent done
track money after the fact and cannot tell you which date will slip, which release clashes with leave or what a week of delay costs

messages.moment: Project manager: tasks without an owner
messages.text: Hello {manager}, {no_owner} tasks on {name} have no owner. Please assign them this week so that the look-ahead is complete.
Hello {approved_by}, version {version} of the baseline of {project} waits for your approval. The new end is {end}. Reason: {reason}.

messages.moment: Project manager: float below the limit
messages.text: Hello {manager}, the float of {name} on {project} is {float_days} days ({state}). Watch owner: {watch}. Please check its links and the people on it.
Hello {manager}, this week on {name}: {week_start} tasks start and {week_due} are due, and {late_n} are overdue. Next milestone: {next_ms}. Please confirm the owners by Monday noon.

messages.moment: Project manager: fixed date at risk
messages.text: Hello {manager}, the fixed date {name} on {project} is {date} and the forecast is {forecast}: {margin} spare days ({state}). Please plan the recovery before a penalty applies.

messages.moment: PMO lead: schedule variance this week
messages.text: Hello, schedule variance on {name}: forecast end {forecast_end} against baseline {end}, {slip} days ({sched}). Manager: {manager}. We review it at the weekly meeting.
Hello, the recovery action for {name} on {project} was due on {due} and is still {status}. Cause: {cause}. Owner: {owner}. Please chase it.
Hello, the week of {start} holds {due_n} due tasks and {hours} planned hours against {capacity} hours of capacity (load {load}). {away} people are away. Please help to level the week.
Hello {sponsor}, the milestone {name} on {project} moved from {planned} to {forecast}. We will tell you the effect on the end date this week.
Hello {sponsor}, the new forecast end of {name} is {forecast_end}. The baseline end is {end}, so the slip is {slip} days. A recovery plan follows.
Hello {sponsor}, the delay on {name} ({project}) comes from: {cause}. Our recovery action is: {action}, due {due}. The recovery plan is attached.

messages.moment: Sponsor: approval needed for the plan
messages.text: Hello {sponsor}, we need your decision this week to hold {name} on {date} ({project}). The forecast is {forecast}, with {margin} spare days. Penalty per week late: {penalty_week}.
Hello {contact}, the milestone {name} of {project} is planned for {forecast} (baseline {planned}). Please keep your reviewers free in that week.

messages.moment: Client contact: your input is needed
messages.text: Hello {who}, we still need {item} for {project} by {needed_by}. We asked on {asked_on}. Please tell us when we will receive it.
Hello {contact}, the release {release} is planned for {date}. The code freeze starts on {freeze}. Please confirm the window and who signs off on your side.

messages.moment: Client contact: change to the schedule
messages.text: Hello {contact}, we moved the end of {name} on {project} from {old_end} to {new_end}. The reason is: {reason}. Please tell us if this affects your plans.
Hello {contact}, our next company closure is on {next_closure}. The plan for {name} already skips it. Please tell us about your own closure days.
Hello {who}, please confirm the delivery date of {item} for {project}. We need it by {needed_by}.

messages.moment: Vendor: delivery is late, new date
messages.text: Hello {who}, {item} for {project} was needed by {needed_by} and we have waited {days_waiting} days. Please send the new date today.
Hello {who}, please confirm your booking dates for {item} on {project}. We asked on {asked_on}. Our owner is {owner}.

documents.title: Project schedule by phase
paragraphs: Project schedule of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:projects.name}. Client: {col:projects.client}. Manager: {col:projects.manager}. Sponsor: {col:projects.sponsor}. Status: {col:projects.status}.

The baseline runs from {col:projects.start} to {col:projects.end}. The forecast end is {col:projects.forecast_end}, which is {col:projects.slip} days against the baseline. The schedule colour is: {col:projects.sched}.
Each phase shows its forecast end and the share of its work done.
Phases 1 and 2: {col:projects.plan_1}.
Phases 3 and 4: {col:projects.plan_2}.
Phases 5 and 6: {col:projects.plan_3}.
Phase 7: {col:projects.plan_4}.

The plan holds {col:projects.tasks_n} tasks. {col:projects.done_n} are done and {col:projects.late_n} are overdue. Work done, weighted by hours: {col:projects.pct_done}. Hours left: {col:projects.hours_left}.

The schedule skips weekends and company holidays. The next company closure is on {col:projects.next_closure}. A change of a date is entered on the Schedule Changes sheet and approved by the sponsor or the PMO lead.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Milestone report
paragraphs: Milestone report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:milestones.project}. Milestone: {col:milestones.name}. Status: {col:milestones.status}.

Baseline date: {col:milestones.planned}. Forecast date: {col:milestones.forecast}. Actual date: {col:milestones.actual}. Slip: {col:milestones.slip} days. The date check shows: {col:milestones.check}.
Sponsor: {col:milestones.sponsor}. Client contact: {col:milestones.contact}.
A milestone is met when it is reached on or before its baseline date. A milestone that moves is reported to the sponsor and the client contact with the reason and the new date.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Baseline approval record
paragraphs: Baseline approval record of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:baselines.project}. Version {col:baselines.version}, set on {col:baselines.date}. Status: {col:baselines.status}.

Baseline start: {col:baselines.start}. Baseline end: {col:baselines.end}. Duration: {col:baselines.duration} days. Change against the version before: {col:baselines.change}. End moved: {col:baselines.moved} days.
Reason: {col:baselines.reason}. Approved by: {col:baselines.approved_by}.
After approval the baseline does not change. A new version is made only for an approved change, and the earlier version stays on record.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Schedule change notice to the client
paragraphs: Schedule change notice of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
To {col:changes.contact}. Project: {col:changes.project}.
We moved the end of the task {col:changes.name} from {col:changes.old_end} to {col:changes.new_end}. That is {col:changes.shift} days, or {col:changes.wshift} working days.
The reason is: {col:changes.reason}. {col:changes.approved_by} approved the change on {col:changes.date}.
Please tell us within three working days if this change affects your plans or the dates you are waiting for. If we do not hear from you, the new date stands.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Delay notice to the sponsor
paragraphs: Delay notice of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
To {col:delays.sponsor}. Project: {col:delays.project}.
The task {col:delays.name} is {col:delays.days_late} days late. We raised the delay on {col:delays.raised}.
The cause is: {col:delays.cause}.
Our recovery action is: {col:delays.action}. Owner: {col:delays.owner}. Due on {col:delays.due}. Status: {col:delays.status}.
Where the cause is outside the team we ask for your support. We will report again when the action is done.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Four-week look-ahead plan
paragraphs: Four-week look-ahead of {set:firm}, dated {today}.

Week starting {col:lookahead.start}. Tasks starting: {col:lookahead.starting}. Tasks due: {col:lookahead.due_n}. Hours planned: {col:lookahead.hours}. Late tasks: {col:lookahead.late_n}. People away: {col:lookahead.away}.
Tasks due in the next three weeks: {col:lookahead.due_w2}, {col:lookahead.due_w3} and {col:lookahead.due_w4}. Hours planned: {col:lookahead.hrs_w2}, {col:lookahead.hrs_w3} and {col:lookahead.hrs_w4}.
Team capacity this week: {col:lookahead.capacity} hours. Load: {col:lookahead.load}, so the week is: {col:lookahead.state}. Holidays in the week: {col:lookahead.holidays_n}.
Owners confirm their tasks on Monday. A heavy week is levelled before it starts.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Critical items report
paragraphs: Critical items report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Task: {col:critical.name} on {col:critical.project}. Task status: {col:critical.task_status}. Days late: {col:critical.days_late}.
Float: {col:critical.float_days} days. The limit in our settings is {set:float_limit} days, so the state is: {col:critical.state}. The driver is: {col:critical.driver}.
Watch owner: {col:critical.watch}. Action: {col:critical.action}. Due on {col:critical.due}. Action state: {col:critical.action_state}.
Every critical item is reviewed on Monday. An item with little float needs a recovery action with an owner and a date.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Release plan
paragraphs: Release plan of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Release: {col:releases.release}. Project: {col:releases.project}. Date: {col:releases.date}. Owner: {col:releases.owner}. Status: {col:releases.status}.
Scope: {col:releases.scope}.

The code freeze starts on {col:releases.freeze}, {set:freeze_days} working days before the release. Days to go: {col:releases.days_to}. State: {col:releases.state}. Window check: {col:releases.window}.
Client contact: {col:releases.contact}. Before the release the owner confirms the freeze, the test result, the way back and the people on call. The client contact confirms the window in writing.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Recovery plan for a late project
paragraphs: Recovery plan of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
Project: {col:projects.name}. Manager: {col:projects.manager}. Sponsor: {col:projects.sponsor}.

The baseline end is {col:projects.end} and the forecast end is {col:projects.forecast_end}. The slip is {col:projects.slip} days, or {col:projects.slip_pct} of the baseline duration. The schedule colour is: {col:projects.sched}.

Hours left: {col:projects.hours_left}. To hold the baseline end the team needs about {col:projects.catch_hours} more hours each week. Overdue tasks: {col:projects.late_n}. Tasks without an owner: {col:projects.no_owner}.

Recovery steps: put more people on the late tasks, start work in parallel where the links allow it, move or cut scope that the sponsor agrees to give up, and remove blockers with the client contact. Each step has an owner and a date.
We review the plan every week until the forecast end is back on the baseline or a new baseline is approved.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

steps.label: Agree the scope and the deliverables
Break the work into phases and work packages
List the tasks and give each one an owner
Estimate every task with three points
Link the tasks and give each link a type and a lag
Check holidays and leave against the dates
Mark the critical items and their float
Set the milestones and the fixed dates
Review the plan with the team
Get the baseline approved
Check the plan against the contract dates
Check that every task has an owner and a predecessor
Write the reason for the version
Send the baseline to the approver
Collect the answer
Store the version and close the earlier one
Tell the team and the client contact
Ask every owner for the percent done
Update the forecast end of late tasks
Check the links of tasks that moved
Review the critical items
Update the delay register
Check the look-ahead for heavy weeks
Send the sponsor note on dates that moved
Save the week and plan the next one
Check the deliverables behind the milestone
Confirm the date with the client contact
Check the people and the leave of that week
Run the final checks
Tell the sponsor if the date will move
Hold the milestone meeting
Record the actual date and the slip
Find the cause and write it in the register
Check how far the end date moves
Choose the recovery action and its owner
Tell the sponsor with the new date
Move the dependent tasks
Update the forecast end of the project
Review the action at the weekly meeting
Close the entry when the task is back on plan
Agree the scope of the release
Check holidays and leave around the date
Confirm the window with the client contact
Plan the final tests
Freeze the code
Confirm the people on call and the way back
Send the release note
Release and record the result
Review what went well and what did not
List the company holidays inside the phase
List the leave of the people in the phase
Check the tasks that fall on those days
Move the dates or name a cover
Tell the team about the changes
Update the look-ahead
Check that all tasks of the phase are done
Compare the forecast with the baseline end
Record the actual hours of the phase
Write the lessons for the next phase
Update the baseline if the sponsor approved a change
Brief the team on the next phase
Collect the approved schedule changes
Rebuild the dates from the new tasks
Check the links, holidays and leave again
Estimate the remaining work
Write the reason for the new version
Send the new baseline for approval
Tell the team and the client contact

ru.Hello {sponsor}, we need your decision t: Здравствуйте, {sponsor}! Нам нужно ваше решение на этой неделе: провести {name} к {date} ({project}). Прогноз: {forecast}, свободных дней: {margin}. Штраф за каждую неделю просрочки: {penalty_week}.
ru.Hello {contact}, the milestone {name} of: Здравствуйте {contact}, веха {name} {project} запланирована на {forecast} (базовая линия {planned}). Пожалуйста, оставьте своих рецензентов свободными на этой неделе.
ru.Client contact: your input is needed: Контактное лицо клиента: нужен ваш вклад
ru.Hello {who}, we still need {item} for {p: Здравствуйте {who}, нам все еще нужен {item} для {project} до {needed_by}. мы спросили на {asked_on}. пожалуйста, скажите нам, когда мы получим его.
ru.Hello {contact}, the release {release} i: Здравствуйте, {contact}! Выпуск {release} запланирован на {date}. Заморозка кода начинается {freeze}. Пожалуйста, подтвердите окно и того, кто подписывает с вашей стороны.
ru.Hello {contact}, we moved the end of {na: Здравствуйте {contact}, мы перенесли конец {name} на {project} из {old_end} в {new_end}. Причина заключается в следующем: {reason}.
ru.Client contact: our closure days: Контактное лицо клиента: наши дни закрытия
ru.Hello {contact}, our next company closur: Здравствуйте {contact}, наш следующий закрытие компании на {next_closure}. План для {name} уже пропускает его. Пожалуйста, расскажите нам о ваших собственных дней закрытия.
ru.Hello {who}, please confirm the delivery: Здравствуйте, {who}! Пожалуйста, подтвердите дату поставки {item} для проекта {project}. Нам нужно это к {needed_by}.
ru.Hello {who}, {item} for {project} was ne: Здравствуйте {who}, {item} для {project} был необходим для {needed_by} и мы ждали {days_waiting} дней. Пожалуйста, отправьте новую дату сегодня.
ru.Hello {who}, please confirm your booking: Здравствуйте, {who}! Пожалуйста, подтвердите даты бронирования для {item} по проекту {project}. Мы запрашивали их {asked_on}. Наш ответственный: {owner}.
ru.Sample wording: adapt it to your own pra: Пример текста: адаптируйте под свою практику.
ru.The baseline runs from {col:projects.sta: Базовая линия длится от {col:projects.start} до {col:projects.end}. Прогнозный конец {col:projects.forecast_end}, что составляет {col:projects.slip} дней по сравнению с базовой линией. Цвет графика: {col:projects.sched}.
ru.Each phase shows its forecast end and th: Каждый этап показывает его прогнозный конец и долю выполненной работы.
ru.The plan holds {col:projects.tasks_n} ta: План содержит {col:projects.tasks_n} задачи. {col:projects.done_n} выполнены и {col:projects.late_n} просрочены. Работа выполнена, взвешенная по часам: {col:projects.pct_done}. Остальные часы: {col:projects.hours_left}.
ru.The schedule skips weekends and company: Расписание пропускает выходные и праздники компании. Следующее закрытие компании: {col:projects.next_closure}. Изменение даты вносится на лист «Изменения графика» и одобряется спонсором или руководителем офиса проектов.
Базовая дата: {col:milestones.planned}. Прогнозная дата: {col:milestones.forecast}. Фактическая дата: {col:milestones.actual}. Слип: {col:milestones.slip} дней. Проверка даты показывает: {col:milestones.check}.
ru.A milestone is met when it is reached on: Мета достигается, когда она достигается в начальную дату или до нее. Мета, которая перемещается, сообщается спонсору и клиенту с причиной и новой датой.
ru.Baseline start: {col:baselines.start}. B: Базовый старт: {col:baselines.start}. Базовый конец: {col:baselines.end}. Длительность: {col:baselines.duration} дней. Изменение по сравнению с версией до: {col:baselines.change}. Конец перенесен: {col:baselines.moved} дней.
ru.After approval the baseline does not cha: После утверждения исходная версия не изменяется, новая версия составляется только для утвержденного изменения, а более ранняя версия остается в записи.
ru.We moved the end of the task {col:change: Мы перенесли конец задачи {col:changes.name} из {col:changes.old_end} в {col:changes.new_end}. это {col:changes.shift} дней, или {col:changes.wshift} рабочих дней.
ru.Please tell us within three working days: Пожалуйста, сообщите нам в течение трех рабочих дней, если это изменение влияет на ваши планы или ожидаемые даты.
ru.The task {col:delays.name} is {col:delay: Задача {col:delays.name} задерживается {col:delays.days_late} днями. Мы увеличили задержку на {col:delays.raised}.
ru.Our recovery action is: {col:delays.acti: Наша операция по возврату: {col:delays.action} Владелец: {col:delays.owner} {col:delays.due} Статус: {col:delays.status}
ru.Where the cause is outside the team we a: Если дело не в команде, мы просим о вашей поддержке.
ru.Week starting {col:lookahead.start}. Tas: Неделя с {col:lookahead.start}. Начинаются задачи: {col:lookahead.starting}. Срок у задач: {col:lookahead.due_n}. Запланировано часов: {col:lookahead.hours}. Просроченные задачи: {col:lookahead.late_n}. Люди в отсутствии: {col:lookahead.away}.
ru.Tasks due in the next three weeks: {col:: Задачи со сроком в следующие три недели: {col:lookahead.due_w2}, {col:lookahead.due_w3} и {col:lookahead.due_w4}. Запланировано часов: {col:lookahead.hrs_w2}, {col:lookahead.hrs_w3} и {col:lookahead.hrs_w4}.
Качество команды на этой неделе: {col:lookahead.capacity} часов. Нагрузка: {col:lookahead.load}, так что неделя: {col:lookahead.state}. Праздники в неделю: {col:lookahead.holidays_n}.
ru.Owners confirm their tasks on Monday. A: Владельцы подтверждают свои задания в понедельник.
ru.Task: {col:critical.name} on {col:critic: Задача: {col:critical.name} на {col:critical.project}. Статус задачи: {col:critical.task_status}. Дни задержки: {col:critical.days_late}.
ru.Float: {col:critical.float_days} days. T: Резерв: {col:critical.float_days} дн. Порог в наших настройках: {set:float_limit} дн., поэтому статус: {col:critical.state}. Ответственный за решение: {col:critical.driver}.
ru.Watch owner: {col:critical.watch}. Actio: Владелец контроля: {col:critical.watch}. Действие: {col:critical.action}. Срок: {col:critical.due}. Статус действия: {col:critical.action_state}.
ru.Every critical item is reviewed on Monda: Каждый критический элемент проверяется в понедельник.
Заморозка кода начинается {col:releases.freeze}, за {set:freeze_days} рабочих дн. до выпуска. Осталось дней: {col:releases.days_to}. Статус: {col:releases.state}. Проверка окна: {col:releases.window}.
Контакт с клиентом: {col:releases.contact}. перед выпуском владелец подтверждает замораживание, результат теста, путь обратно и людей на дежурстве. Контакт с клиентом подтверждает окно в письменной форме.
ru.The baseline end is {col:projects.end} a: Конец базовой линии - {col:projects.end} и конец прогноза - {col:projects.forecast_end}. Слип - {col:projects.slip} дней, или {col:projects.slip_pct} продолжительности базовой линии. Цвет графика: {col:projects.sched}.
ru.Hours left: {col:projects.hours_left}. T: Осталось часов: {col:projects.hours_left}. Чтобы сохранить базовую дату окончания, команде нужно примерно {col:projects.catch_hours} дополнительных часов в неделю. Просроченные задачи: {col:projects.late_n}. Задачи без владельца: {col:projects.no_owner}.
ru.Recovery steps: put more people on the l: Шаги восстановления: увеличить количество людей на поздние задачи, начать работу параллельно, если это позволяют ссылки, переместить или сократить объем, который спонсор соглашается отказаться, и удалить блокировщики с контактом клиента.
ru.We review the plan every week until the: Мы пересматриваем план каждую неделю, пока прогноз не вернется на базовую линию или не будет утверждена новая база.
ru.Break the work into phases and work pack: Разделите работу на этапы и пакеты работ
ru.List the tasks and give each one an owne: Перечислите задачи и назначьте каждой владельца
ru.Link the tasks and give each link a type: Свяжите задачи, укажите тип связи и лаг
ru.Check holidays and leave against the dat: Проверьте праздники и отпуска по датам
ru.Mark the critical items and their float: Отметьте критические задачи и их резерв
ru.Check that every task has an owner and a: Проверьте, что у каждой задачи есть владелец и предшественник
ru.Tell the team and the client contact: Сообщите команде и контактному лицу клиента
ru.Ask every owner for the percent done: Запросите у каждого владельца процент выполнения
ru.Send the sponsor note on dates that move: Отправьте спонсору записку о сдвинутых датах
ru.Check the people and the leave of that w: Проверьте людей и отсутствия на этой неделе
ru.Find the cause and write it in the regis: Найдите причину и запишите ее в реестре
ru.Choose the recovery action and its owner: Выберите меру восстановления и ее владельца
ru.Close the entry when the task is back on: Закройте запись, когда задача вернется в план
ru.Check holidays and leave around the date: Проверьте праздники и отсутствия вокруг даты
ru.Confirm the window with the client conta: Подтвердите окно с контактным лицом клиента
ru.Review what went well and what did not: Проанализируйте, что прошло хорошо, а что нет
ru.Check the tasks that fall on those days: Проверьте задачи, которые выпадают в эти дни
ru.Check that all tasks of the phase are do: Проверьте, что все задачи фазы выполнены
ru.Update the baseline if the sponsor appro: Обновите базовый план, если спонсор одобрил изменение
ru.Check the links, holidays and leave agai: Проверьте связи, праздники и отсутствия еще раз
ru.Send the new baseline for approval: Отправьте новый базовый план на утверждение
ru.Estimated against actual hours per phase: Оценка против фактических часов по фазам
ru.Open Start and type your company name an: Откройте "Начать" и введите в желтые ячейки название компании и свои лимиты: дни предупреждения, лимит плавания, цвета графика, фокус-поделка и дни замораживания кода.
ru.List your projects on Projects and your: Перечислите ваши проекты на проектах и ваших людей на команде. конец базовой линии, конец прогноза, менеджер и спонсор сидят на ряду проекта; слайд и цвет заполнить.
ru.Break each project into phases and work: Разделите каждый проект на фазы и пакеты работы на Распределение работ, затем перечислите задачи на Список задач с владельцем, датами, предполагаемыми часами, процентом выполненных работ и статусом.
ru.Link tasks on Dependencies with a link t: Ссылка задач на зависимости с типом ссылки и задержкой. Колонка проверки находит отсутствующие, круговые и противоречивые ссылки, прежде чем они повредят плану.
ru.Enter company holidays on Holidays and l: Введите праздники компании на праздники и отпуск на Оставьте календарь. Рабочие дни показывает рабочие дни и рабочее время команды каждого месяца и каждый конечный день пропускает дни закрытия.
ru.Set milestones, fixed dates and releases: Установка этапов, фиксированных дат и выпусков на этапах Фиксированные даты и выпусков.
ru.Keep each approved plan on Baselines and: Сохраняйте каждый утвержденный план на базе и даты каждого этапа на План этапов.
ru.Use Three-point Estimates before you com: Используйте Оценка в три пункта до того, как вы обязались часами и Точность оценки после завершения задач, так что следующая оценка начинается с вашей собственной истории.
ru.Every Monday read Look-ahead and Critica: Каждый понедельник смотрите прогноз на недели и критические пункты: тяжелые недели, людей в отсутствии, задачи с малым резервом, а также действие и владельца по каждому.
ru.Use the 14 calculators for end dates, wo: Используйте 14 калькуляторов для дат окончания, рабочих дней, расчетов, продолжительности, плавающей величины, буфера, воздействия задержки, прогнозного конца, догонения, смены, окна выпуска, одобрения и стоимость задержки.
ru.Print 10 sheets and 9 documents, follow: Напечатайте 10 листов и 9 документов, следуйте 9 контрольным спискам и нажмите на ссылку сообщения, чтобы открыть приложение для обмена сообщениями с готовым текстом.
ru.Read Schedule Dashboard and Charts every: Читайте Диспетчерская панель расписания и графики каждую неделю и отправьте спонсорскую записку до перехода дат, а не после.
ru.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Все выпадающие списки книги. Измените пункт здесь — он обновится на всех листах.
ru.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Данные обновляются по вашим листам. Измените год, чтобы посмотреть прошлые периоды.
ru.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Выберите значение в жёлтой ячейке — остальные заполнятся автоматически. Готово к печати.
ru.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Измените текст здесь; слова в скобках подставляются из каждой строки. Ссылки находятся в таблицах.
ru.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Выберите запись — для каждого этапа появится срок. Создайте копию листа для каждой записи.
ru.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Актуальные диаграммы по данным ваших листов. Выберите значения в жёлтых ячейках — диаграммы и индикаторы обновятся автоматически.

tr.Plan, schedule and keep every project on: Her projeyi planlayın ve tarihlerinde tutun

tr.baseline and forecast end, percent done: Her projenin her aşaması için temel ve tahmini bitiş, tamamlanma yüzdesi ve kayma; aşamanın görevlerinden hesaplanır.

tr.the code freeze date, working days left: Her sürüm için kod dondurma tarihi, kalan iş günleri ve kapalı günler ile izinlerin kontrolü.
tr.Fixed dates with spare days and penalty: Yedek günlü sabit tarihler ve ceza riski

tr.Float days at or below which a task is c: Görevin kritik sayıldığı boşluk (gün), bu değere eşit veya altında

tr.Task list: dates, owner, progress and wh: Görev listesi: tarih, sahip, ilerleme ve program durumu
